svg.title: Mobile and Savannah keep 9 in 10 large ships to the head port; the Hudson and James keep fewer than 1 in 15

cc:Work.dc:title: Mobile and Savannah keep 9 in 10 large ships to the head port; the Hudson and James keep fewer than 1 in 15
cc:Work.dc:description: Fifteen step lines, one per river or ship channel, of large ships as a share of entrance traffic against distance as a share of corridor length, colored by how many reach the head port; Mobile and Savannah stay near 1 to the head, while the James, Hudson, Sacramento, and Mississippi fall to about 0.1 or less.
